text:
sophia: Hey all — I accepted the org invite but when I try to view a private repo I get: \"To access this organization you must enable two-factor authentication\". I already enabled 2FA on my GitHub account just now. Who should I ask to get my repo/team access fixed?

rachel: Welcome, sophia! Two quick things: (1) which GitHub account did you accept the invite with (work vs personal), and (2) did you enable 2FA on that same account? Sometimes people accept with a personal account by accident.

sophia: I initially clicked the invite link from my personal email (sophia.personal+gh@gmail.com) before realizing I should use sophia@redwood.ai. I just enabled 2FA on sophia@redwood.ai and connected Okta SSO — but I still can't see redwood/secure-playbooks.

platform-bot: Onboarding note: sophia (sophia@redwood.ai) — SSO connected: yes; 2FA: enabled (TOTP); Detected separate GitHub account (sophia.personal+gh@gmail.com) previously accepted invite. Flagging platform team to reconcile accounts and resend invite if needed.

tom-platform: Hi! Looks like GitHub treated the personal acceptance as an outside-collaborator event and never auto-assigned team membership to your work account. Two things I did: (1) revoked the outside-collab entry for your personal account, (2) re-sent the invite to sophia@redwood.ai and queued a team auto-assign. Note: org requires 2FA and there's sometimes a short delay after enabling 2FA before GitHub honors membership checks — give it ~60s then retry.

sophia: Thanks. I got the new invite and accepted. How can I verify locally that my work account is the one GH sees?

rachel: Quick checks: (CLI) run `gh auth status` to confirm which account GH/gh is authenticated as. Then run `gh api /user/teams --jq '.[] .name'` to list teams after auth. Or check GitHub.com -> your profile -> Organizations -> Teams.

tom-platform: I re-ran the team-sync and added you to infra-docs (read/write) while we waited for the membership to propagate. Try pushing to your branch now to trigger the preview: 
```bash
git checkout -b docs/fix-typo
# make change
git add content/playbook.md
git commit -m \"docs: fix typo in playbook\"
git push --set-upstream origin docs/fix-typo
```

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: sophia 1 invited to work account, 2FA enabled, team-sync requested. Follow-up: add onboarding note about not accepting invites from personal emails.

sophia: Push succeeded and I can see private repo now. Thanks everyone! One odd thing: when I first enabled 2FA GitHub still showed the org access error for ~90s — good to know it's eventually consistent.

tom-platform: Filed ONB-421 to add a tiny note to the onboarding flow: \"Do not accept org invites from personal accounts; enable 2FA on your work account before accepting.\" Also adding a small retry delay in the invite email copy. Closing this thread once you confirm everything works.

sophia: Confirmed, all good. Closing.
